# fhires

Go package with struct definitions for [FHIR](https://hl7.org/fhir/) v5 [resources](https://hl7.org/fhir/resourcelist.html). Must-have for type-safe handling of FHIR requests and responses.

Features:

* FHIR v5.0.0.
* Uses the modern [JSON v2](https://pkg.go.dev/encoding/json/v2)
* Defines tags for JSON, XML, and BSON.
* Autogenerated from official specs.

## Installation

```bash
go get github.com/orsinium-labs/fhires
```

## Usage

```go
import (
    "encoding/json/v2"
    "github.com/orsinium-labs/fhires/fhires"
)

var patient fhir.Patient
err := json.Unmarshal(data, &patient)
```
